senses.en_definition: Colloquial short form of itu: that; that one; that matter. Also used after a noun to mean ‘that …’.

messages.en: Which shop did we say we'd meet at again? The one in front of the bank?
Yeah, that one. I'm already here, sitting at a table outside.
Okay, hang on a sec. I'm just across the road.

collocations.en: an elderly person; one's parents, depending on context

senses.en_definition: Older than someone else; senior in age.
Old; ancient; having existed for a long time.
An elder, chief, or head of a household, traditionally respected for knowledge and experience.

collocations.en: the head of a household (traditional title)

senses.en_definition: Late or far advanced, of the night.

collocations.en: it is already late at night

senses.en_definition: Believed to possess supernatural powers or special potency, especially of old weapons.

collocations.en: an old kris believed to possess supernatural powers, depending on context
iron objects believed to possess special powers (traditional usage)

senses.en_definition: Mature and ready to be picked, though not necessarily fully ripe, of fruit.

collocations.en: fruit mature enough to be picked

senses.en_definition: Brought to the boil, of water; heated sufficiently for cooking, of oil.

collocations.en: let the oil heat up sufficiently first

senses.en_definition: Of high purity; nearly pure, of gold.

collocations.en: a ring made of high-purity gold

messages.en: I'm sending you a photo of these two tops. Which looks nicer, the light blue one or the dark blue one?
Go for the dark blue one. It'll go well with your black trousers.

senses.en_definition: Sir; a respectful title or form of address for a man, especially one holding an official position.
You; a formal, respectful form of address for the person being spoken to.
An owner or proprietor; also a host in tuan rumah.
A master; a person whom a slave or servant serves or belongs to.

collocations.en: you; sir (a respectful form of address in classical Malay)
the big boss; the superintendent of a plantation or similar establishment (historical)

senses.en_definition: A respectful title or form of address for a noblewoman in classical Malay.

collocations.en: to have an audience with the princess

messages.en: Hello, sir. Your items are ready. Will you be picking them up this afternoon?
Yes, but I probably won't get there until around six. What time do you close?
Seven, sir. Please send me a message when you're nearly here.

senses.en_definition: Your Majesty; Your Highness; a respectful form of direct address to a ruler, with the English equivalent depending on rank.

collocations.en: Pardon me, Your Majesty (a formal expression used when addressing a ruler)

senses.en_definition: My master; my lord; literally tuan with the first-person possessive suffix -ku.

collocations.en: my kind master (in a personified narrative)
my Lord and Saviour (in a Christian context)

messages.en: If we have to speak to the Sultan tomorrow, we address him as Tuanku, right? I'm worried I'll get it wrong.
Yes, Tuanku. But we'd better check the full wording with the organisers first.
Okay, I'll ask the organisers in a bit. I'll share their reply in the group chat.
